summary: Iteration 2 - face recognition attendance + location accuracy improvements tested. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering smoke, RBAC, face enroll (invalid descriptor 400, success + status flip + DB persistence + descriptor never leaked), file serving (401 anon / 200 authed), attendance check-in without enrollment (400), full flow check-in+ping+checkout with descriptor+image_b64, low-accuracy (>500m) ping skipped (no DB write), good-accuracy ping stored, mismatched descriptor rejected (403), admin /attendance includes check_in_photo_path + check_out_photo_path + accuracy fields, admin /route includes accuracy & photo paths, admin DELETE /face resets enrollment. Frontend: 7/7 critical flows pass - unauthenticated login-google-button visible, unenrolled user redirected to /enroll, enrollment page renders with start-enrollment-btn + 'Enroll your face' heading, enrolled admin lands directly on /admin (no enroll redirect), Photos column header present in attendance log, accuracy values (e.g. ±12m) displayed under In/Out times, photo modal opens when clicking photo button (verified with real uploaded object-storage path).

minor.issue: Legacy users created before face feature do not have face_enrolled / face_photo_path fields in their Mongo docs, so the response omits them entirely. Frontend should treat missing as false. Consider defaulting these fields server-side via projection or migration.

action_items: Optional: backfill face_enrolled=false on legacy user docs OR set default in projection so admin UI never sees undefined.
Optional: in /api/admin/employees response, project face_enrolled with $ifNull so it is always returned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py face/enroll & checkin/checkout: object-storage 'put' is synchronous (requests.put) inside async handler - blocks the event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run in threadpool for production scale.

server.py /api/files/{path}: any authenticated user can fetch ANY file path - there's no ownership check. An employee could enumerate other users' face photos by guessing paths (paths include uuids so brute-force is hard, but path tokens leak through admin endpoints). Consider scoping access to admin OR file-owner.
server.py storage_key is a module-level mutable global; concurrent first-init may double-init. Add a lock or rely on idempotent init.
server.py FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD=0.55 hardcoded - move to env / config for tuning without redeploy.
server.py admin/employees: legacy users miss face_enrolled key entirely. Project with $ifNull or set default at serialization.
AuthPhoto.jsx: handles errors with fallback, good - but when fallback is null (default), nothing renders and there is no visible error state for admin debugging.
FaceEnroll.jsx routes to admin or dashboard via user?.role read BEFORE checkAuth refresh fully resolves - tiny race; safe because checkAuth is awaited but worth double-checking.
Backend now_utc().date() used for 'today_str' is server-side UTC - users in IST will see day boundary shift at 5:30 AM local. If admin reports are expected per local day, add timezone awareness.
test_credentials: Seeded directly: admin TEST_user_admin01 / token TEST_session_admin_001 (face_enrolled=true, descriptor=[0.0]*128). Employee TEST_user_emp01 / token TEST_session_employee_001 (face_enrolled=true, same descriptor). Unenrolled TEST_user_emp_noface / TEST_session_unenrolled_001. Frontend: FE_admin / FE_emp tokens for redirect tests (cleaned up at end).
seed_data_creation: pytest fixtures auto-seed users + sessions and clean up; one real face/enroll API call performed against object storage to obtain a valid photo path used in the photo-modal frontend test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_api.py. conftest seeds admin & employee with face_enrolled=true and a [0.0]*128 descriptor; matching check-in/out calls reuse that descriptor (face_distance ~ 0). To regression-test descriptor mismatch, send all-1.0 descriptor (euclidean ~11.3, well above 0.55 threshold). For /api/files/* tests you must first POST /api/face/enroll to upload a real object and reuse the returned photo_path. To test frontend admin photo modal end-to-end you must (a) seed a TEST_ attendance record with check_in_photo_path referencing an actually-uploaded object, and (b) set face_enrolled=true on the admin so they aren't redirected to /enroll. Headless face-capture UI cannot be e2e tested - skip.
rca of the issue: Single backend minor: GET /api/admin/employees omits face_enrolled for legacy users (field missing in Mongo doc). Fix: project via $ifNull or migrate. No other bugs found - all face recognition, accuracy filtering (>500m skipped), photo storage/retrieval, and admin photo-modal flows work as specified.
